# Codex Token Bar v0.5.2
这次更新主要修复未读会话提醒、账号额度回跳、登录项启动崩溃和启动/滚动阶段的可靠性问题，同时继续收口本地数据读取和发布安全检查。
## 更新亮点
- 修复未读会话提醒漏报：现在会更忠实地读取 Codex 的官方未读列表，不再因为 `has_user_event` 或暂未写入 SQLite 的会话而漏掉提醒，同时仍会过滤 subagent 和归档会话。 - 修复额度历史回跳：同一个重置周期内会忽略晚到的旧额度快照，避免 5h / 7d 剩余额度出现不合理的反向上升。 - 修复登录项启动崩溃：开机自启或后台启动时不再过早切换 AppKit 激活状态。 - 改进启动数据稳定性：快速统计已经显示后，即使后续精确扫描失败，也不会把主界面统计和 24h 图表清空。 - 修复悬浮窗多开残留：反复开关悬浮窗或出现多个主窗口实例时，会自动收口到唯一悬浮窗，并清理失联的旧面板，避免出现关不掉的第二、第三个悬浮窗。 - 降低悬浮窗锁定后的空闲开销：稳定跟随目标窗口后减少系统窗口枚举频率，降低常驻能耗。 - 收口本地数据层：统一 SQLite 访问、缓存读取、额度读取和 JSONL 解析的测试覆盖，减少后续统计口径漂移。 - 改进发布预检：继续保留 Sparkle 更新签名、DMG 背景检查、Hardened Runtime / Sandbox 发布门禁和权限说明检查。
## 更新说明
- 这仍然是本地优先版本：App 只读取本地 Codex 文件和 Codex 账户额度接口，不上传 prompt、输出、日志或额度历史。 - Sparkle 更新仍然需要用户确认，不会在后台静默替换 App。 - 当前构建仍是 ad-hoc 签名，尚未 Apple notarize。如果 macOS 提示“未知开发者”，请从官方 Release 下载并校验 SHA256 后再打开。
---
## English
This update focuses on unread session reminders, quota regression handling, launch-at-login stability, and startup/chart reliability, while tightening local data access and release checks.
## Highlights
- Fixes missed unread session reminders: the app now trusts Codex's official unread list more closely, no longer dropping reminders solely because `has_user_event` is false or a thread has not reached SQLite yet, while still filtering subagents and archived threads. - Fixes quota history regressions: stale late-arriving quota snapshots are ignored within the same reset cycle, preventing 5h / 7d remaining quota from jumping upward incorrectly. - Fixes a launch-at-login crash caused by switching the AppKit activation policy too early during startup. - Improves startup data stability: once the fast snapshot is visible, a later precise scan failure no longer clears dashboard totals or recent charts. - Fixes duplicate floating panel leftovers: repeated floating-panel toggles or multiple dashboard instances now converge to one active panel and clean up orphaned panels, preventing unclosable second or third floating windows. - Lowers idle cost for locked floating panels by reducing system window enumeration once the target window is stable. - Tightens the local data layer with unified SQLite access and broader tests for cache loading, quota reading, JSONL parsing, and realtime unread filtering. - Improves release checks around Sparkle update signatures, styled DMG validation, Hardened Runtime / Sandbox gates, and permission descriptions.
## Update Notes
- Codex Token Bar remains local-first: it reads local Codex files and account quota APIs, and does not upload prompts, outputs, logs, or quota history. - Sparkle updates still require user confirmation; the app does not silently replace itself in the background. - The app remains ad-hoc signed and is not Apple notarized. Verify the SHA256 checksum before opening if macOS warns about an unidentified developer.

# Codex Token Bar v0.5.1
这次是一次比较大的体验和可靠性更新，重点打磨账号额度、悬浮/状态栏 token 显示、未读会话提醒、本地修复工具和最近用量曲线。
## 更新亮点
- 增强账号额度显示：加入 5h / 7d 额度历史、重置时间、本地轻量心跳记录和更紧凑的节奏提示。 - 新增重置卡详情：从 Codex 本地账户接口读取可用重置机会，展示卡片状态、到期时间、关联头像和来源说明。 - 加入未读会话提醒：Codex 任务完成后，如果对应会话还没点开，悬浮窗会显示柔和的涟漪或扫光提醒，点开后自动收起。 - 改进悬浮 token 小窗：支持更可靠的缩放、自定义背景渐变、透明度、速率满格值、提醒样式和窗口锁定跟随。 - 完善状态栏实时模式：菜单栏直接显示实时 tok/s，点击可展开白色详情卡，查看累计 Token、今日用量、额度和实时组成。 - 增加缓存命中分析：支持按每日、每小时、会话和单轮对话查看缓存命中率，并在最近用量图中显示命中率曲线。 - 优化 24h / 7d / 30d 曲线：修正平滑过冲、hover 点错位、额度线断裂，并利用重置时间补齐额度曲线。 - 重做“会话消失修复”流程：把扫描、备份、修复、验证做成更清晰的步骤，并加入备份回滚列表。 - 优化启动和滚动性能：减少重复数据库读取，缓存热力图和曲线准备结果，移除低价值的大面积视觉特效，并修复宽窗口两侧留白区域无法滚动的问题。 - 修复多项本地数据边界问题：包括 fork 会话 token 重放尖峰、subagent 未读误报、Codex Desktop 侧边栏可见性修复逻辑等。
## 更新说明
- Sparkle 会在开启自动更新后读取 GitHub appcast，也可以通过 `Codex Token Bar -> Check for Updates...` 手动检查。 - 更新仍然需要用户确认；App 不会在后台静默替换本地应用。 - 当前构建仍是 ad-hoc 签名，尚未 Apple notarize。如果 macOS 提示“未知开发者”，请从官方 Release 下载并校验 SHA256 后再打开。 - DMG 安装包流程加入背景图、拖拽布局和窗口尺寸验收，减少安装窗口缺背景或说明文字被截断的问题。 - Codex Token Bar 仍然保持本地优先：只读取本地 Codex 文件和账户额度接口，不上传 prompt、输出、日志或额度历史。
---
## English
This release is a large polish pass for quota visibility, floating and menu-bar token displays, unread session reminders, local repair tools, and chart reliability.
## Highlights
- Adds richer account quota visibility, including 5h / 7d quota history, reset timing, local heartbeat samples, and compact pace hints. - Adds reset-credit details from Codex's local account API, with readable card status, expiry, user avatar, and source information. - Adds unread session reminders: when a Codex task finishes and the session has not been opened yet, the floating panel can show a subtle ripple or shimmer cue and clear it after the session is opened. - Improves the floating token meter with better scaling, custom background gradients, opacity controls, configurable full-scale rate, reminder styles, and a more reliable window-lock mode. - Improves the menu-bar realtime mode: the menu bar can show live tok/s directly, and clicking it opens a white detail card with totals, today's usage, quota, and realtime breakdowns. - Adds cache-hit analytics across daily, hourly, session, and turn-level views, including cache hit-rate display in the recent usage chart. - Refines the 24h / 7d / 30d usage chart with better smoothing, aligned hover points, optional quota lines, and reset-time-aware quota continuity. - Reworks the session disappearance repair flow with clearer scan / backup / repair / verify steps and a rollback list for previous backups. - Improves startup and scroll performance by reducing repeated database work, caching expensive chart preparation, removing low-value heavy visual effects, and fixing scroll hit-testing in wide-window side gutters. - Fixes several local-data edge cases, including forked-session token replay spikes, unread subagent filtering, and Codex Desktop sidebar visibility repair logic.
## Update Notes
- Sparkle checks the GitHub appcast when automatic update checks are enabled, or when you choose `Codex Token Bar -> Check for Updates...`. - Updates are still user-confirmed; the app does not silently install a new version in the background. - The app remains ad-hoc signed and is not Apple notarized. Verify the SHA256 checksum before opening if macOS warns about an unidentified developer. - The DMG packaging flow now validates the installer background, drag-to-Applications layout, and Finder window size to avoid missing backgrounds or clipped guidance text. - Codex Token Bar remains local-first: it reads local Codex files and account quota APIs, and does not upload prompts, outputs, logs, or quota history.

# Codex Token Bar v0.3.1
This release polishes the first-run experience, update path, and the live dashboard details.
## Highlights
- New first-run setup guide: confirms the Codex directory, recommends launch-at-login, and lets you enable automatic update checks. - New menu bar control: open the main window, check for updates, toggle automatic update checks, toggle launch-at-login, or quit from the macOS status bar. - Launch-at-login now starts quietly after setup, keeping the floating/status token meter available without opening the full dashboard. - Account quota display now shows a retry hint when quota reading fails, so transient network/API failures are easier to recover from. - The recent 24-hour chart hover card now appears only while hovering and floats above the curve without clipping at the edges. - The activity mode selector and README screenshots were refreshed to show cache hit rate, quota lines, and the new floating panel layout. - Release packaging keeps the styled DMG background and the Sparkle update signature checks from the v0.3.0 release line.
## Update Notes
- Sparkle checks the GitHub appcast when automatic update checks are enabled, or when you choose `Codex Token Bar -> Check for Updates...`. - Updates are still user-confirmed; the app does not silently install a new version in the background. - The app remains ad-hoc signed and is not Apple notarized. Verify the SHA256 checksum before opening if macOS warns about an unidentified developer.

# Codex Token Bar v0.3.0
This release turns Codex Token Bar into a fuller local usage console while keeping the app local-first.
## Highlights
- Adds Sparkle-based in-app update checking with signed update metadata. - Adds a DMG release package, checksums, and a versioned app zip for updates. - Adds account quota tracking with 5h / 7d trend lines, local hourly heartbeat storage, and compact pace hints. - Adds cache-hit analytics by day, hour, session, and turn, including a cache hit-rate curve in the 24h chart. - Improves the floating token-rate panel with quota context, scaling, opacity, and default-on first launch behavior. - Improves the session disappearance repair flow with a guided scan / backup / repair / verify workflow and rollback list. - Reduces scroll jank by removing low-value large shadows and moving expensive controls off hot render paths.
## Notes
- The app remains ad-hoc signed and is not Apple notarized. Verify the SHA256 checksum before opening if macOS warns about an unidentified developer. - The app reads local Codex data only. It does not upload prompts, outputs, logs, or account quota data.
